blurb: Set sail on a 12-hour fishing adventure that takes you deep into the Gulf Stream, over 55 miles off the coast of North Myrtle Beach. This trip is perfect for both novices and seasoned anglers, offering a chance to reel in a variety of fish including Red Snapper, Grouper, and even King Mackerel. All fishing gear, bait, and licenses are included, so you can focus on the thrill of the catch. Bring your own food and drinks or grab a bite from the onboard snack bar. With experienced captains leading the way, make the most of your day at sea.
